turns.match: how do I mend a flat bike tyre, one step at a time
turns.script:
scene layout=figure
color tyre=#3a3a3a
color tube=#e8a33d
color metal=#9aa5b1
circle rim 50,40 20 fill=metal thick=1
circle tire 50,40 30 fill=tyre thick=1
circle tub 50,40 24 fill=tube thick=1
pick s steps | 1 Take the wheel off | 2 Lever the tyre | 3 Swap the tube | 4 Pump it up
bind s=1 | correct cap | Flip the bike, open the brake and release the quick-release lever. Slide the wheel out.
bind s=1 | set tub opacity=0.2
bind s=1 | set tire fill=tyre
say cap | Four steps to mend a flat: tap through them.
bind s=2 | correct cap | Slip two levers under one side of the tyre and walk them round the rim.
bind s=2 | set tire fill=metal
bind s=2 | set tub opacity=0.6
bind s=3 | correct cap | Pull the old tube out, run a finger round the tyre for thorns, and fit the new tube.
bind s=3 | set tub fill=tube
bind s=3 | set tub opacity=1
bind s=4 | correct cap | Seat the tyre back on the rim and pump to the pressure printed on its side.
bind s=4 | set tire fill=tyre
bind s=4 | set tub opacity=1
say x2 choice | What size levers do I need
